blob_offset_index.note: Monotonically decreasing offsets into the SASS blob. Each entry is 16 bytes: u64 blob_offset + u64 tag.

high_entropy_blob.note: ~2.8 MB of near-maximum entropy data (8.00 bits/byte) starting immediately at 0x1D4FF40. Preceded by a 607-entry blob offset index (0x1D4D950-0x1D4FF40). Likely compressed/encrypted NVVM IR templates, pre-built code sequences, or encoded lookup tables.
